//: Talking (15 §11; 12 §10.7; decision D-799). The control `talk` (shift+t) and the context menu's Talk first ask the application for the service `talk` with whom to talk to, then open this screen about them. The application gathers what the character could say to them, the options rules leave on the hook `talk_options`, on a copy of the simulation, so that asking changes nothing; `app.talk` reads them. Each says something with the action `say`, named bare here: whichever loaded mod's action of that name comes first in order of id (the `core` mod's takes `to`, `kind` and `lines`). What anyone says back is heard by the character and written in the log by playback.
